summary: Displaay's Vue microsite for Avantt (8 weights + italics, variable wght 100–900, 'inspired by architectural functionalism'). The Wayback capture never got past the preloader: the Vue app (#app) mounted empty and two stylesheets were blocked, so only the two-colour preloader screen was recorded. No components could be extracted; the site needs a live re-capture.

instances.look: Preloader only: a magenta (#c40052) panel 536px wide on the left and a warm grey (#757165) field filling the rest of the 1440×900 screen, no text; the same frame for the whole 14s recording, mobile shows the magenta panel stacked above grey
instances.ux: The Vue app never mounted on the Wayback copy (empty #app, 4 console errors, Avantt variable woff2 requested but 'unloaded')
instances.learn: Even the preloader is brand-coded: a fixed accent column in the site's two colours holds the layout before the app renders

reconstruction.layout: #preloaderAccentPart absolute left 0, width 536px, full height, #c3004f; body background grey; below 1200px the accent becomes a full-width top band calc(50vw + 190px) tall (calc(50vw + 92px) below 850px)
reconstruction.typography: none rendered; fonts declared: Avantt variable (wght 100–900) roman and italic woff2
reconstruction.behaviour: Static until the app loads (never happened in this capture)
